metadata.case_name: WAI YIN WA v. LAMINATE ENTERPRISES LIMITED

injuries.description: Crush injury to right forearm and right hand
source: the Plaintiff's right hand was trapped between the rollers of a machine and she sustained injury to her right forearm and right hand.
injuries.icd_description: Crushing injury of wrist or hand

injuries.description: Post-Compartment syndrome of stiffness of right hand and forearm.
source: Post-Compartment syndrome of stiffness of right hand and forearm.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles or tendons at forearm level
Other specified injuries to the elbow or forearm

injuries.description: Right forearm and hand dermatitis and cellulities.
source: Right forearm and hand dermatitis and cellulities.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the elbow or forearm

source: the clinical diagnosis was reflex sympathetic dystrophy ("RSD").

injuries.description: Shoulder-hand syndrome and Volkmann's ischaemic contracture (as part of combined orthopaedic effect).
source: a combination of the effect of "Shoulder-hand syndrome, Volkmann's ischaemic contracture and reflex sympathetic dystrophy".
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles or tendons at forearm level

source: I find that the Plaintiff was not suffering from MDD, but DD, a comparatively less serious condition.

manifestations.description: Bruise and tender, dorsal aspect of right forearm
Bruise and tender, dorsal aspect of the right hand

Severe swelling on her right hand, fingers and forearm; 5x5 cm discoloured blister over her mid-dorsal forearm and another necrotic ulcer distally; extensive dermatitis with minor blistering of variable sizes over her right forearm and hand
Stiffness of right hand and forearm
Loss of much use of right limb
Depression, of moderate severity and tendency to recur
Inability to work (loss of working ability)

treatments_received: Attended Accident and Emergency Unit of Kwong Wah Hospital and discharged with pain killers and 7 days' sick leave
Herbal treatment (type unspecified) after discharge from KWH
Admitted to Hong Kong Baptist Hospital on 27th May 1994
Split thickness skin graft operation on 6th June 1994
Pressure-garment treatment from 29th June to 30th August 1994
Physiotherapy treatment from 5th January to 7th August 1995 and from 2nd September to 29th September 1995
Orthopaedic follow-up at United Christian Hospital on 28th December 1994

Psychiatric treatment: first seen at UCH psychiatric unit on 17th May 1995; inpatient admissions August 1995, October 1995, April 1997; Electroconvulsive therapy (two courses); depot Haldol injection; admission to PYNEH on 7th October 1997; inpatient from 5th July to 14th August 1999 and again on 13th September 1999 (inpatient at time of hearing)
treatments_future: Private psychotherapy for 2 years: half-hourly session once a week in the first 12 months, once a fortnight in the next 12 months (assessment basis adopted by Court)
Possible future inpatient psychiatric treatment (contingency considered)

losses.description: Loss of much use of right limb (reduced function of right forearm and right hand).

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Claimed inability to properly cook and reliance on ready made food (Plaintiff's testimony).
Insomnia, low mood, anxiety Depression, of moderate severity and tendency to recur

comparable_cases.injury_description: General range of awards for 'serious injury' $60,000 to $80,000 and for 'substantial injury' $80,000 to $100,000 (as cited).
Updated ranges cited: serious $400,000 to $540,000 and substantial $540,000 to $660,000 (judgment in July 1996).
